name: Alvinnn!!! and The Chipmunks
description: Everyone's favorite chipmunks -- Alvin, Simon and Theodore -- are back in this computer-animated version of the classic animated series. The brothers are famous rock stars who tour around the world with their best friends, the Chipettes.

credits_cast.character: Alvin Seville (Voice) / Simon Seville (Voice) / Dave Seville (Voice)
credits_cast.name: Ross Bagdasarian Jr.

credits_cast.character: Theodore Seville (voice) / Brittany Miller (voice) / Jeanette Miller (voice)
credits_cast.name: Janice Karman

videos.title: Alvin's Got A Brand New Bag
Dave Rebooted
videos.overview: Dave gets temporary amnesia so the boys trick him into letting them skip school and go on a ski trip instead.

videos.title: Germs
videos.overview: Theodore becomes obsessed with cleanliness after a school speaker talks about the danger of germs.

videos.title: A Rose by Any Other Name
Girls Night Out
videos.overview: Dave discovers he's not too good at roughing it outdoors when he goes on a day hike with the Chipettes.

videos.title: Tables Turned
videos.overview: When Alvin pranks Simon with a trick website, the chipettes prank Alvin back.

videos.title: Switcheroo
videos.overview: Theodore's teddy bear is bear-napped, forcing the boys to work with Officer Dangus to get him back.

videos.title: The Paperboy
videos.overview: Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, but Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay up.

videos.title: Talking Teddy's Revenge
videos.overview: Alvin thinks Theodore's teddy bear can tell the future, and goes all out to make Talking Teddy his friend.

videos.title: Snail-A-Palooza
videos.overview: Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, so Dave forces Alvin to make the holiday real.

videos.title: Pizza Dash
videos.overview: Simon creates a drone that can not only deliver pizzas, but has the ability to learn.

videos.title: Glory Days
videos.overview: Alvin worries that the munks are responsible for making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star.

videos.title: Britt's Picks
videos.overview: Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog and vows to get him back.

videos.title: The Devil Wears Rodentia
videos.overview: Brittany's dream of being a fashion designer turns into a nightmare when her ideas are stolen.

videos.title: The C Team
videos.overview: Coach Dobkins challenges Miss Smith and her ragtag team of outcasts to a baseball game to see who's the best.

videos.title: The Toy
videos.overview: A favorite toy of Theodore's is lost on a rafting trip but then mysteriously shows up at the house, and it's alive.

videos.title: Theodore's Calling
videos.overview: Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his true calling in life.

videos.title: Clumsy Jeanette
videos.overview: Jeanette is suddenly the clumsiest person on the planet. Is there something wrong with her - or her new glasses?

videos.title: Adventures in Babysitting
videos.overview: Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's babysitting sitting job with a spoiled four year old.

videos.title: Alvin's Assistant
videos.overview: Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant to get closer to the music industry, but ends up running errands instead.

videos.title: Big Bro Theodore
videos.overview: When Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother, he tries to be a better role model for Alvin and Simon.

videos.title: Granny Awards
videos.overview: Dave is thrilled when he thinks he's nominated for a Grammy, but it's actually an award for aging musicians.

videos.title: Mysterions
videos.overview: When Theodore discovers Alvin and Simon have a secret club, he promises not to tell anyone if they let him join.

videos.title: The Crow That Ate My Homework
videos.overview: Dave promises to take Alvin to a water park if he gets a good grade on his test, but then a crow steals it.

videos.title: Alvin Management
videos.overview: When Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, a therapist moves in to help Dave control his anger.

videos.title: Time Capsule
videos.overview: Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, so a therapist moves in;  when the school digs up an old high school time capsule, Miss Smith and Dave work together to keep an old secret.

videos.title: Munk vs Machine
videos.overview: The Chipmunks and Chipettes team up together to compete in a dodgeball tournament. They learned that an opposing team has an unfair advantage using technology. Later on, they discovered that an enraged Theodore could be their secret weapon.

videos.title: Artsy Smartsy
videos.overview: Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in order to complete an art assignment for art class.

videos.title: Between a Rope and a Hard Place
Taken
videos.overview: The boy's imaginations run wild when Dave disappears. When they finally find him, they're convinced he's a zombie.
